goal_features.statement: Flexible advanced computing coursework and a capstone support preparation for applied computing careers; no placement outcome is promised.
NYU Tandon lists MSCS research opportunities in algorithms, cybersecurity and other computing fields. Participation depends on access and individual arrangements.

directory_policies.notes.9: Research opportunities: Tandon lists algorithms, cybersecurity, responsible AI and other computing groups that MSCS students can explore.

fact_summary: The Tandon MSCS page lists customizable computing electives and research groups in areas including algorithms and security.
